label: Lazada Sponsored Solutions
terms_note: FAQ read; no API and no automation clause mentioned

discovery.auth: hmac (LazOP app key + app secret signature + seller access_token after seller authorization)

reference.verdict: **Verdict** — has_api: **yes** (LSS Open API on the Lazada Open Platform).
auth: 1. Register as a LazOP developer (open.lazada.com) → create an application → App Key + App Secret.
2. Request API permission for Sponsored Solutions; the seller authorizes the app (seller authorization flow) → `access_token` (+ refresh).
3. Sign requests (HMAC-SHA256 over sorted params with app secret; `sign`, `timestamp`, `app_key`, `access_token`).

endpoints.notes: campaign name, daily budget, start/end, status

reference.limits: - LazOP per-app call quotas (TODO(verify)); Developer Agreement + ToS; free.
mcp_sdk: Official LazOP SDKs (Java / PHP / Python) on the Open Platform (TODO(verify) links).

config_fields.name: api_domain
config_fields.help: Regional API host of the seller's venture: api.lazada.sg, api.lazada.com.my, api.lazada.com.ph, api.lazada.co.th, api.lazada.co.id or api.lazada.vn (Service Endpoints of each Sponsored Solutions API).

fields.name: app_key
fields.help: App Key of your Lazada Open Platform app with the Sponsored Solutions API permission (App Console).

fields.name: app_secret
fields.help: App Secret of the same app; signs every call and the token refresh (uppercase hex HMAC-SHA256 over the API name + sorted name/value pairs). Never sent on the wire.

fields.name: refresh_token
fields.help: Seller refresh_token from /auth/token/create after the seller authorised the app; the runtime mints access tokens with the signed /auth/token/refresh (https://auth.lazada.com/rest) and keeps the refresh_token it returns ('The refresh token cannot be refreshed': when refresh_expires_in runs out the seller must re-authorise). Set PLATFORM_MCP_STATE_DIR so the newest one survives restarts.

adapter.terms: Lazada Open Platform Sponsored Solutions API (https://open.lazada.com/apps/doc/api?path=%2Fsponsor%2Fsolutions%2Fcampaign%2FsearchCampaignList): calls to https://api.lazada.<venture>/rest/sponsor/solutions/… carry app_key, timestamp (ms), sign_method=sha256, access_token and sign = uppercase hex HMAC-SHA256(app_secret, API name + sorted name/value pairs) (https://open.lazada.com/apps/doc/doc?nodeId=10450&docId=108068). Seller tokens are renewed with the signed system API /auth/token/refresh on https://auth.lazada.com/rest. Answers {code ('0' = success), success, result, errorMsg, request_id}; gateway errors carry code/message.

me.note: getAccountSignInfo: whether the seller has signed the Sponsored Solutions agreement (result boolean); verifies the app key, signature and seller token.

list_campaigns.note: searchCampaignList (bizCode sponsoredSearch = Sponsored Discovery) with the last 7 days as the metrics window: campaignId, campaignName, dailyBudget, startDate, endDate, status (combined on/off), campaignSwitchStatus (1 online, 0 offline — mapped to status), budget/balance/schedule flags and the window's impressions, clicks, ctr, cpc, spend, store orders and revenue (strings, '-' = no data; all in raw). totalCount is the number of campaigns. account_id and status are not sent (the seller token selects the shop).

get_report.note: getDiscoveryReportCampaign (Sponsored Discovery, campaign level, startDate/endDate yyyy-MM-dd, first 100 rows): per campaign impressions, clicks, ctr, cpc, spend, store/product orders, units, revenue, ROI and dayBudget. campaign_id filters to one campaign; useRtTable (realtime data for today) is not sent.

update_budget.note: updateCampaign {campaignId, bizCode sponsoredSearch, dayBudget} — 'the maximum amount you're willing to pay each day' in the shop currency. This spends money; currency is ignored.

pause_resume.note: updateCampaign {campaignId, bizCode sponsoredSearch, switchStatus: 1 online | 0 offline} (pause → 0, resume → 1). Resuming restarts spend.

not_offered.list_accounts: The Sponsored Solutions API acts for the seller whose token is used; its account calls report agreement status and auto top-up settings (getAccountSignInfo, getLatestSignInfo, sign, wallet …AutoTopUp…), none lists ad accounts (Sponsored Solutions API category, https://open.lazada.com/apps/doc/api).

evidence: host api.lazada.sg: DNS ok, TLSv1.2 (GlobalSign nv-sa)
probe: 5/5 tools answered on their documented path with an auth refusal, a validation error or data; control route answered 200 too, so the host authenticates before routing
HTML docs spot-check (render-doc): 5/5 tool paths found verbatim on their docs pages; every parameter and body key named on the page
